recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle cinematic shot of a woman in a wide-brimmed hat leaning out of a vintage white open-top tour vehicle against a clear blue sky, topped with bold, stacked retro typography in red and blue.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally between the vehicle and the sky
Primary text elements occupying the top third of the frame
Color coordination between the red hat, red text, and blue sky/blue text
Contrast between the sharp, flat graphic text and the soft, sun-lit photography
coreInvariants: Sun-drenched, warm lighting with soft shadows
White vehicle body acting as a secondary canvas for graphics

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is small in scale, positioned centrally in the middle ground, framed by the vehicle's edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red display text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top red text, move down to the blue secondary text, then drop to the subject and the vehicle graphics.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of clear sky provides breathing room for the heavy typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale blue (sky) and off-white (vehicle) provide the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red is used for primary text and fashion accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Navy blue is used for secondary text and vehicle decals.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red and blue graphics against a desaturated, warm-toned photographic base.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed sans-serif and geometric inline sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: extremely tall x-height, narrow width, flat terminals
Secondary text: geometric, multi-line inline strokes, interlocking 'O' characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking double 'O' in the secondary line
Triple-line vertical strokes for the secondary font
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme verticality paired with airy geometric linework.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ultra-condensed, heavy vertical presence of the primary text.
Matches the industrial, flat-terminal feel of the top line.
Approximates the multi-line, airy feel of the second line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of a woman in a red sun hat and white shirt leaning out of a vintage white open-top tour bus. The background is a clear, bright blue sky. The lighting is warm, golden-hour style with soft shadows on the vehicle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text in the upper third. Top line: ultra-condensed bold red sans-serif. Bottom line: navy blue geometric inline font with wide tracking and interlocking circular characters.

verificationChecks: Is the top text ultra-condensed and red?
Does the second line of text feature an inline/multi-line style?
Is the sky a clear, pale blue without clouds?
Is the subject wearing a red hat that echoes the text color?

adjustableVariables: Hat color and text color coordination
mustRedesign: Specific vehicle logos and phone numbers
Artist name and album title wording
Specific star and wave graphic on the vehicle

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not touch the subject's head
Check that the red in the hat matches the red in the text
Verify the inline font has distinct internal lines
Confirm the vehicle looks like a 20th-century model
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sun-drenched vintage cinematic photograph with heavy, vertically-stretched red sans-serif and airy navy blue inline geometric typography.
